description.zh: 修改后的节点配置内容。
任务节点ID，可调用[GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task node. You can call the [GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~) operation to query the node ID.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the ["View information about the current tenant"](~~181330~~) section of the Manage DMS tenants topic.

descriptions.zh: 该接口可用于修改节点配置内容。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to modify node configurations.
